findings.statement: A compact quadrature reconstruction response transfers to the two reserved run periods under this educational-skim contract.
findings.applicability: 2015 four-lepton educational skim, no MC or control background supplied. Object recoil and MET share reconstruction components; predictive agreement is not independent discovery of momentum conservation or new physics. The source is a selected four-lepton sample without the Monte Carlo/control samples needed to identify background, missing particles or detector-resolution components causally.

findings.falsification: The source is a selected four-lepton sample without the Monte Carlo/control samples needed to identify background, missing particles or detector-resolution components causally.
findings.prior_art: The source studies and domain constructions are disclosed in PRIOR_ART.json. This campaign does not certify broad novelty.
